title: Cartwise+ Member Booster on Everyday Pay Card Cashback, Cartwise Shopper Payouts
content:
# Member booster schedule: Everyday Pay Card statement payments

A shopper who is also a Cartwise+ member earns a booster on the cashback paid by a statement payment on an Everyday Pay Card plan of Cartwise Shopper Payouts. The booster is decided by the shopper's Cartwise+ Membership as it stands on the day of the payment: the plan name of the membership and whether that membership is active.

**Rule.** A member booster applies to the cashback due before the cap. A shopper holding an active Cartwise+ Premier Annual or Cartwise+ Family Annual membership has it multiplied by 1.1; a shopper holding any other active Cartwise+ membership has it multiplied by 1.05; and a shopper with no active Cartwise+ membership has it unchanged. The boosted figure is rounded to the cent before the cap.

## Booster by membership held

| Cartwise+ Membership on the payment day | Cashback due is multiplied by |
|---|---|
| Active Cartwise+ Premier Annual | 1.1 |
| Active Cartwise+ Family Annual | 1.1 |
| Active Cartwise+ Assist Monthly, Cartwise+ Student Monthly, Cartwise+ Monthly or Cartwise+ Annual | 1.05 |
| No active Cartwise+ membership (none held, or the membership held is not active) | unchanged |

## Points of application

- The booster acts on the cashback due, the figure before the cap, and the boosted figure is rounded to the cent at that point; the cap then applies to the boosted, rounded figure.
- The booster does not enter the test of whether a statement payment is owed: that test looks at the cashback due before any booster.
- Only an active membership counts. A membership in any other state gives no booster.

## Illustration (hypothetical figures)

Hypothetical cashback due of 23.45 on the payment day:

- active Cartwise+ Family Annual: 23.45 multiplied by 1.1 is 25.795, rounded to 25.80;
- active Cartwise+ Monthly: 23.45 multiplied by 1.05 is 24.6225, rounded to 24.62;
- no active membership: 23.45.
